errors.generic: That didn't work just now. Try again in a moment.
errors.network: We couldn't reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to do that.
errors.tooManyRequests: Too many attempts in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.
errors.notListField: This field is no longer a list. Reload the page and try again.
errors.invalidMapping: Enter between 1 and 500 pairs of values to replace.
errors.invalidTargetKey: That field name doesn't make a valid key. Use letters and numbers.

quickReplies.description: Ready-made texts to reply faster. In a conversation, type <kbd>/</kbd> in the message box and pick one by its shortcut.
quickReplies.missingAttachment_one: This message cites an attachment that was deleted. Remove the red block or insert another file: as it stands, the conversation gets a code instead of the file.
quickReplies.missingAttachment_other: This message cites {{count}} attachments that were deleted. Remove the red blocks or insert other files: as it stands, the conversation gets a code instead of the file.
quickReplies.unknownVariables_one: Nothing fills in the variable {{names}}: it isn't from the contact or from a custom field. When the message is inserted, it stays in the text for you to complete by hand.
quickReplies.unknownVariables_other: Nothing fills in the variables {{names}}: they aren't from the contact or from a custom field. When the message is inserted, they stay in the text for you to complete by hand.

empty.title: No quick replies yet

noResults.title: No messages found
noResults.description: Try another search or clear the filters.

create.title: New quick reply
create.description: In a conversation, it shows up when someone types / and the shortcut.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: The shortcut /{{trigger}} stops showing up in conversations. What was already sent stays as it is, and the cited attachments stay in the library.

fields.nameRequired: Give it a name so you can find it later.

editor.noAttachments: The library is still empty. Upload the first file below.
editor.slashHint: Type / to insert an attachment or variable

preview.title: How it looks in the conversation
preview.empty: Write the message to see how the contact receives it.
preview.missing: Deleted attachment: a code goes out instead of the file.
preview.variablesHint: Example with made-up data. Variables are filled in when the message is inserted into the conversation, and whatever the contact doesn't have stays in the text to complete by hand.
preview.strippedHint: Sending removes quotes, brackets, backticks, tildes and greater-than and less-than signs, as shown above.

attachments.description: Your organization's files, ready to use in quick replies, chat, campaigns and flows.

empty.title: No files here yet
empty.description: Upload the price lists, catalogs and photos you always send, and use them in quick replies and conversations.

noResults.title: No files found
noResults.description: Try another search or clear the filters.

upload.title: Upload files
upload.leaveDescription: Whatever hasn't finished uploading will be canceled.

fields.name: Name
fields.nameRequired: Give it a name so you can find it later.
fields.descriptionPlaceholder: What it's for, or when to use it
fields.replaceFileHint: Quick replies that cite this attachment start sending the new file.

viewer.noPreviewDescription: This file doesn't open inside the page. Use the buttons at the top to download it or open it in a new tab.

usage.title: Where it's used
usage.none: No quick reply cites this file.
usage.scope: Shows quick replies only. Flows and campaigns aren't counted yet.

delete.title: Delete {{name}}?
delete.description: The file leaves the library. What was already sent in conversations stays there. Any flow or campaign using this file will be left without it.
delete.descriptionUsed_one: The quick reply {{names}} cites this file: once it's deleted, it sends a code instead of the file until someone edits it. Any flow or campaign using this file will also be left without it.
delete.descriptionUsed_other: The quick replies {{names}} cite this file: once it's deleted, they send a code instead of the file until someone edits them. Any flow or campaign using this file will also be left without it.

customFields.description: What you want to keep about each contact besides name and phone: city, size, how they found you. Each field shows up in conversations, contacts and filters.

typeHints.number: Can be filtered by greater and less than.
typeHints.list: One option among those you define.

empty.title: No custom fields yet
empty.description: Create a field to keep what matters about each contact, and filter conversations by it.

noResults.title: No fields found
noResults.description: Try another search or clear the filters.

create.title: New field
create.description: It starts showing up in every conversation and contact.

delete.title: Delete the field {{name}}?
delete.description: The field disappears from conversations, contacts and filters. If you create another one with the same name, it will show whatever is already stored.
delete.descriptionFilled_one: The field disappears from conversations, contacts and filters. The value in {{count}} conversation stays stored there, without showing: if you create another field with the same name, it comes back.
delete.descriptionFilled_other: The field disappears from conversations, contacts and filters. The values in {{count}} conversations stay stored there, without showing: if you create another field with the same name, they come back.

fields.name: Name
fields.nameTooLong: Use up to 255 characters in the name.
fields.nameNeedsLetters: Use letters or numbers in the name.
fields.keyTaken: The field {{name}} already uses the key {{key}}. Choose another name.
fields.keyPreview: The key will be {{key}}. It doesn't change after it's created, even if you rename the field.
fields.keyEmptyHint: The key comes from the name and doesn't change after it's created.
fields.keyLocked: The key doesn't change when you rename: it's how the values are stored in conversations. In quick replies, it becomes the variable {{variable}}.
fields.descriptionTooLong: Use up to 500 characters in the description.
fields.typeChangeHint: Changing the type doesn't alter values already stored in conversations.
fields.optionsPlaceholder: Type an option and press Enter
fields.optionsHint: Separate with commas to add several at once.
fields.optionsLiveHint: Each option applies right away, no need to save. Agents can also create options from inside a conversation.
fields.losingOptions: When you save, this field's list of options will be erased. Values already stored in conversations stay.
fields.autoNormalizeHint: Every new value becomes a number: “20 to 40/day” turns into “20”. If there's no number, it stays as it came.
fields.targetHint: Choose another number field to keep what was typed.
fields.defaultValueHint: Used when the conversation has no value in this field yet.
fields.defaultNeedsOptions: Add options to choose a default value.

options.removeDescription: It can no longer be chosen. Conversations that already have this value keep it.
options.removeDefaultDescription: It's this field's default value, so the field ends up with no default. Conversations that already have this value keep it.

values.truncated: Showing only the 500 most used values.

empty.title: No conversation has this field filled in
empty.description: Once someone fills it in, the values show up here.

emptyPeriod.title: Nothing in this period
emptyPeriod.description: No conversation created on these dates has this field filled in.

values.mappingIntro: Write the new value for each line. Whatever stays blank doesn't change, and nothing is saved until you check it.
values.suggestTitle: Pull the number out of each value
values.suggestHint: “R$ 50.000,00/month” becomes “50000”. For ranges, such as “20 to 40/day”, choose which number to use.
values.noSuggestions: No value has a number to suggest.
values.reviewWarning_one: {{formatted}} conversation will be updated. This can't be undone.
values.reviewWarning_other: {{formatted}} conversations will be updated. This can't be undone.
values.reviewNothing: No conversation has these values. Go back and check the mapping or the period.
values.destinationSame: In this field, replacing the current value
values.destinationOther: In another field, keeping the original
values.targetHint: If the field doesn't exist, it's created when you apply.
values.targetExisting: Stores in the key {{key}}. Whatever is already there in these conversations will be replaced.
values.targetNew: Creates the field when you apply, with the key {{key}}.
values.convertToNumber: Turn this field into a Number, to filter by greater and less than
values.newOptions_one: {{names}} isn't an option of this field yet: it joins the list when you apply.
values.newOptions_other: {{names}} aren't options of this field yet: they join the list when you apply.
values.applyDescription: The current values will be replaced, and it can't be undone.
values.applyDescriptionOther: The original field stays as it is. Whatever is already in {{name}} in these conversations will be replaced, and it can't be undone.
